experiment_data.hypothesis: SmolVLA unpruned baseline on LIBERO-Spatial establishes the reference success rate for C2 cross-suite pixel-shuffle entanglement analysis. Without pruning, the pixel-shuffle connector preserves full spatial information, providing the upper-bound SR against which pruned variants will be compared to quantify entanglement-induced degradation.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u eval_official_libero.py --pretrained_dir /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/smolvla_libero_official/ --suite libero_spatial --mode baseline --num_episodes 50 --seed 42 --gpu 0 --output eval_results/smolvla_baseline_spatial_seed42.json
spec.eval_data: LIBERO-Spatial (10 standard base tasks, 280 max steps each)
